svg.title: Reachability pilot: lateral offset and heading bounds against sampled fault runs
svg.desc: Synthetic data (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Upper bound of the reachable lateral offset and heading under any LKA command the panda passes, from fault onset: the Julia set for commands held per plant step, the exact bound for any command within the panda envelope and without the panda ramp, the largest value over the sampled runs of the nonlinear plant, and the driver correction time of the hard-over run.
svg.text: Reach-set bound vs sampled LKA torque faults · 110 km/h, straight road
Julia 1.11.7 with LazySets; 62 sampled runs, real panda code, nonlinear L1 plant
